start.title: The Voice from Above
start.text:
A voice fills the sky.
"Noah — build an ark. A flood is coming."

choices.feedback: The voice fades. But the weight in your chest remains.
Your voice trembles, but the words are true.
No answer comes. Only the command remains.

mockery.title: Voices of the Crowd
mockery.text:
Villagers gather, laughing.
"A boat? Here? You are mad, old man."

choices.feedback: Your words only feed their mockery.
Their laughter fades behind your steady hands.
They turn their backs. You are alone in faith.

building.title: Cypress and Pitch
building.text:
Years of sweat. Wood splits. Pitch seals.
Your back aches, but the ark rises.

choices.text: Rest a while, the work is endless
choices.feedback: Doubt creeps in with the silence.
Each plank is a prayer. Each beam, a promise.

ark_done.title: It Stands Finished
ark_done.text:
The ark towers above you.
Your family gathers, silent before the wood.

choices.feedback: Pride poisons the work. You catch yourself.

choices.text: Thank God for the strength given
choices.feedback: Your knees bend. The work was never yours alone.

animals.title: Two by Two
animals.text:
Creatures come from every land.
Lions beside lambs. Eagles at your feet.

choices.feedback: Fear blinds you. God sent every one.
They walk past you in peace, as if they always knew.

boarding.title: The Door Closes
boarding.text:
Your family is inside. The animals settle.
God Himself shuts the door.

choices.text: Run back out to warn them again
choices.feedback: The door is sealed. The choice has been made.

choices.text: Hold your wife's hand and wait
choices.feedback: Together. Whatever comes — together.

storm.title: The Heavens Open
storm.text:
Rain crashes like nothing seen before.
The deep bursts. The world drowns.

choices.feedback: The sound swallows your cry.

choices.text: Trust that God is just and merciful
choices.feedback: You bow your head. The ark holds.

choices.text: Try to pull strangers from the water
choices.feedback: The door is sealed. There is nothing to be done.

inside.title: Forty Days
inside.text:
The ark rocks. The animals breathe.
Days blur. Only the creak of wood remains.

choices.feedback: Purpose holds the darkness at bay.

choices.text: Sit alone and let despair grow
choices.feedback: The silence presses on you. Faith dims.

dove.title: The Dove Returns
dove.text:
You release a dove. Hours pass.
It comes back — an olive leaf in its beak.

choices.feedback: Even now, doubt fights to hold you.
Tears fall on the small green leaf. Hope is real.

dry_land.title: Earth Beneath Your Feet
dry_land.text:
The door opens. Sun spills in.
You step onto warm, living mud.

choices.text: Rush to claim the new land
choices.feedback: The land was never yours to claim.

choices.text: Kneel and build an altar to God
choices.feedback: The first stone is for the One who saved you.

covenant.title: The Rainbow
covenant.text:
A rainbow arcs across the sky.
"Never again. This is my covenant with you."
